title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a nice overall mix but thin bass; the first set shines while the show feels solid yet not spectacular.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is generally clear and pleasant, though several listeners note a lack of low‑end that makes the bass feel buried. The concert delivers a strong first set (with a highlighted Jack Straw) and an improved second set compared to earlier releases, but many feel the night was a step down from surrounding shows, giving it a mixed energy level.

ai_rating.rationale: Average show ratings (2‑4 stars) combined with generally positive comments on the recording quality but a recurring complaint about weak bass lead to a mid‑range overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and pleasant overall, but bass is noticeably thin in the mix, making low frequencies feel recessed.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set praised as strong; second set regarded as an upgrade over a previous version, yet the overall night is seen as less energetic than adjacent concerts.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry's playing is highlighted in the title ('Smokin' Set I') and generally praised.
